info.name: Vaccine
info.description: Global vaccine query (/vaccines) with filters: vaccinationRecordId, petId, status, and name (all combined filters must match). PROPOSED DESIGN: These GET endpoints do not exist yet (see PRERREQUISITOS_BACKEND.md). Vaccine CRUD operations remain nested under /vaccinationRecords/{id}/vaccines (VaccinationRecordVaccines collection); this endpoint is only used to prepare the data. SELF-CONTAINED COLLECTION: Creates its own shelter, pets, vaccination records, and vaccines. The status is updated automatically (an overdue booster dose results in false) BEFORE filtering by status.
